headlines.title: North Carolina woman vanishes after swim on Grenada beach vacation
headlines.description: Elizabeth Waddell, 44, of Cary, North Carolina, was last seen at Grand Anse Beach on Wednesday, the Royal Grenada Police Force said in a missing person alert issued Thursday.

headlines.title: Influencer killed by husband after she accused him of pedophilia on TikTok
headlines.description: Social media influencer Sara Gilson was killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records.

headlines.title: Video helps free man from death row
headlines.description: A Louisiana man was recently released after nearly three decades on death row for a murder multiple judges now agree never happened. Jimmie Duncan won his freedom with the help of a video that the jury did not see in his trial. NBC News’ Dan Slepian reports.

headlines.title: Tensions grow in Wisconsin as family of Corey Ruiz speaks out
headlines.description: The family of Corey Ruiz is speaking out after his fatal shooting by a police officer in Madison, Wisconsin. NBC News' Shaquille Brewster has the latest on the what the family is saying and the tension rising in the city.

headlines.title: Measles cases hit 35-year high in 2026
headlines.description: The Center for Disease Control is reporting a new 35-year high in the number of measles cases as new outbreaks pop up in multiple states. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal has more on what this means and how to protect yourself.

headlines.title: Ryan Reynolds-backed distillery closes as share of Americans drinking alcohol hits new low
headlines.description: Ryan Reynolds’ Portland gin distillery – once advertised as “Disneyland for adults” – just poured its last drink. It comes as booze brands struggle to adapt with barely half of Americans saying they consume alcohol, a record low. NBC News’ Camila Bernal reports.

headlines.description: Amazon’s newest Fire TV Stick HD is on sale for $20, down from $35. Here’s what makes this upgraded, ultra-portable streaming device worth buying now.

headlines.title: New Year's Eve ball drops in Times Square for America's 250th
headlines.description: The New Year's Eve ball in Times Square has dropped for America's 250th anniversary, making this the first time the ball has dropped outside of a New Year's celebration.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Berlin police shot and killed the suspect in this weekend’s deadly attack during the city’s Pride festival after he allegedly charged at officers with a knife while they tried to arrest him Sunday, authorities said.
